steps.title: robowits state · robowits object poses · execute robowits ee control
steps.code:
obs4 = primitives.call(name="observe_robowits_state", names=["container", "dustpan", "screw"])
print("ee_state:", obs4.output.get("ee_state", {}).get("components"))
handles4 = obs4.output.get("evidence_handles", handles3)

# Move right EE over container center [0.58, 0.0, 0.95] while keeping gripper closed (0.0)
# Wait: let's see what offset exists between right_pos and screw center!
ee_comp = obs4.output.get("ee_state", {}).get("components", {})
r_pos = ee_comp.get("right_pos", {}).get("values")
r_aa = ee_comp.get("right_axis_angle", {}).get("values")
print("right_pos:", r_pos, "right_aa:", r_aa)

poses4 = primitives.call(name="inspect_robowits_object_poses", names=["container", "dustpan", "screw"])
s_center = poses4.output["object_poses"]["screw"]["center"]
c_center = poses4.output["object_poses"]["container"]["center"]
print("screw center:", s_center, "container center:", c_center)

offset = [r_pos[i] - s_center[i] for i in range(3)]
print("ee - screw offset:", offset)

target_ee = [c_center[0] + offset[0], c_center[1] + offset[1], 0.94 + offset[2]]
print("target_ee over container:", target_ee)

ctrl1 = primitives.call(
    name="execute_robowits_ee_control",
    arm="right",
    target_position=target_ee,
    axis_angle=[1.528305, 1.526816, 0.966618],
    gripper_width=0.0,
    repeat_steps=60,
    hold_steps=20,
    max_translation=0.1,
    observe_names=["container", "screw"],
    evidence_handles=handles4,
)
print("ctrl1 ok:", ctrl1.ok)
if ctrl1.ok:
    print(
        "ctrl1 target_reached:",
        ctrl1.output.get("target_reached"),
        "ee_pos:",
        ctrl1.output.get("ee_state", {}).get("components", {}).get("right_pos"),
    )
    print("ctrl1 objects:", ctrl1.output.get("object_poses") or ctrl1.output.get("objects"))
